candidate_evidence.quote: These sessions will involve simulation-based, caregiving skill training, and your caregiver will be taught skills to help support you (such as feeding, hygiene, mobility, medication administration, and care coordination).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: patients diagnosed with HGG receiving any form of cancer treatment (including palliative intent) at MDACC.

coder_notes: Behavioural caregiver skills-training study (Phase NA); no drugs. Population is high-grade glioma; glioblastoma not named. The detailed description mentions a wait-list control (WLC) group in Trial 2, but the registered OTHER arms are a baseline assessment and the caregiver intervention; neither is clearly a control arm, so control_arm_from_other_arms coded no (could be yes if the baseline-assessment arm is the WLC).
